goal: Prepare and run the representative reviewer-quality study that tests whether PruefPilot findings and next actions are actually useful to qualified reviewers.
constraints: Use synthetic or approved non-sensitive cases.
Keep consequential authority outside the model.
done_when: A representative case set and reviewer rubric exist.
Study outputs capture correctness, corrections and hand-off quality.
The pack is ready for a qualified human reviewer without hidden assumptions.
uncertainties: Qualified reviewer judgement is intentionally not fabricated and remains the next external evidence gate.
next_step: Run pytest, deterministic evals, harness checks and reviewer-study validation; if green, hand the pack back to Michael for reviewer selection/approval.

decision_estimate.rationale: This turns PruefPilot from a polished demo into measurable reviewer evidence and directly strengthens the proof story for near-term applications and pilots.
